title: Non-antibiotic pharmaceutical phenylbutazone binding to MexR reduces the antibiotic susceptibility of Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Dong, Limin; Sun, Lang; Yang, Yan; Yuan, Lin; Gao, Wei; Yu, Dan; Meng, Qinghong; Shi, Wei; Wang, Qing; Li, Yue; Zhang, Youwen; You, Xuefu; Yao, Kaihu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗炎药苯基保泰松与铜绿假单胞菌外排泵调控因子MexR蛋白的结合，通过MD模拟和突变分析揭示其削弱抗生素敏感性的机制，属于蛋白-小分子互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance has been an increasingly serious threat to global public health. The contribution of non-antibiotic pharmaceuticals to the development of antibiotic resistance has been overlooked. Our study found that the anti-inflammatory drug phenylbutazone could protect P. aeruginosa against antibiotic mediated killing by binding to the efflux pump regulator MexR. In this study, antibiotic activity against P. aeruginosa alone or in combination with phenylbutazone was evaluated in vitro and in vivo. Resazurin accumulation assay, transcriptomic sequencing, and PISA assay were conducted to explore the underlying mechanism for the reduced antibiotic susceptibility caused by phenylbutazone. Then EMSA, ITC, molecular dynamic simulations, and amino acid substitutions were used to investigate the interactions between phenylbutazone and MexR. We found that phenylbutazone could reduce the susceptibility of P. aeruginosa to multiple antibiotics, including parts of beta-lactams, fluoroquinolones, tetracyclines, and macrolides. Phenylbutazone could directly bind to MexR, then promote MexR dissociating from the mexA-mexR intergenic region and de-repress the expression of MexAB-OprM efflux pump. The overexpressed MexAB-OprM pump resulted in the reduced antibiotic susceptibility. And the His41 and Arg21 residues of MexR were involved in the phenylbutazone-MexR interaction. We hope this study would imply the potential risk of antibiotic resistance caused by non-antibiotic pharmaceuticals.
abstract_zh: 抗菌药物耐药性已成为日益严重的全球公共卫生威胁。非抗生素类药物对抗生素耐药性发展的贡献一直被忽视。我们的研究发现，抗炎药物保泰松（phenylbutazone）通过结合外排泵调节因子MexR，能够保护铜绿假单胞菌（P. aeruginosa）免受抗生素介导的杀伤。在本研究中，我们评估了单独使用抗生素或与保泰松联合使用时对铜绿假单胞菌的体外和体内抗菌活性。通过刃天青积累实验（Resazurin accumulation assay）、转录组测序（transcriptomic sequencing）和PISA实验，探讨了保泰松降低抗生素敏感性的潜在机制。随后，利用EMSA、ITC、分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）和氨基酸替换实验，研究了保泰松与MexR之间的相互作用。我们发现，保泰松能降低铜绿假单胞菌对多种抗生素的敏感性，包括部分β-内酰胺类、氟喹诺酮类、四环素类和大环内酯类抗生素。保泰松可直接结合MexR，促进MexR从mexA-mexR基因间区解离，并解除对MexAB-OprM外排泵表达的抑制。过表达的MexAB-OprM外排泵导致了抗生素敏感性的降低。MexR的His41和Arg21残基参与了保泰松与MexR的相互作用。我们希望这项研究能提示非抗生素类药物引起抗生素耐药性的潜在风险。
